what_it_is: Pomodoro card with Start/Pause toggle, Reset, phase label and completed counter, beep on phase end.
note: Logic and counter work, but after the first work phase the body gets the class container break-mode: layout shifts to the left edge and the timer digits become teal on teal (invisible). After Reset the label still says Break while the time is 25:00.

what_it_is: Pomodoro timer with Start, Pause, Reset buttons and a completed work phases counter, plus a beep.
note: Interval is not cleared when a phase ends: the next phase keeps ticking by itself with Pause disabled and a second click starts a second interval (double speed). Mode label stays Work during the break, counter increments at the end of the break instead of the work phase (stayed 0 after a work phase). Start button relabelled Pause does nothing.

what_it_is: Light red Pomodoro card with Start/Pause toggle, Reset and a Completed counter.
note: All items work: pause, phase switch to 5:00 break with counter 1, reset to 25:00 focus (also zeroes the counter). Generic, Pause shares Start button.

what_it_is: Pomodoro timer with Start/Pause toggle, Reset, focus/short-break label and a (non-updating) session counter.
note: Timer, phase switch, pause and reset work. The completed counter variable increments but the displayed count stays 0 forever (never written to the DOM), so the counter requirement fails.

what_it_is: Pomodoro card with Work/Break segmented tabs, Start/Pause toggle, Reset and completed work phase counter.
note: All brief items work: pause, phase switch to 5:00 break with counter 1, reset keeps current phase. Tabs for manual mode are a small extra; no sound, no auto-start.

what_it_is: Pomodoro timer with a single Start/Pause toggle button, Reset, work/break colour switch and a completed-phases counter.
note: Start/pause toggle, reset and counter (increments after work phase, switches to 5:00 break) all work; no auto-start of next phase, no sound/title. Generic.

what_it_is: Dark Pomodoro timer with one Start/Pause button, a small Reset text link, a completed-work counter and spoken announcements at phase end.
note: Timer, pause, phase switch and counter work, but the mode label keeps saying Work during the 5-min break, Reset is a tiny duplicated text link that also zeroes the counter. Speech synthesis announcement is a small extra.

what_it_is: Tip calculator with bill, people, 10/15/20 % buttons, a 0-100 slider and a custom % field; shows total tip, tip per person and a tip/bill-share subtext.
note: Tip math correct (80, 15%, 4 -> tip 12, 3 each; custom 18 -> 14.40). Custom field is hidden until a preset or the slider is used (label 'Custom Tip' shown with no input), so it is awkward but reachable. Never shows total owed per person (subtext 3.00 / 20.00 is cryptic); negative bill gives negative tip. Slider is an own idea.

what_it_is: Tip calculator showing tip, tip per person and total per person; people prefilled 2, 15% preselected.
note: Math correct (80, 15%, 4 -> tip 12, tip/person 3, total/person 23); shows both per-person tip and total; error message for invalid input. Custom % input is display:none and never revealed, so custom tip unreachable; error shown on load before any input.

what_it_is: Tip calculator with header banner, bill input, +/- people stepper, preset buttons, reset; shows tip and total per person.
note: Math correct (80, 15%, 4 people -> 12 / 23; custom 18 -> 14.40 / 23.60 when typed). But the custom % input is rendered invisible (opacity 0, clipped, absolute) so users cannot see or click it. Clearing the bill leaves a stale per-person amount; +/- stepper for people is a nice twist; reset button.

what_it_is: Tip calculator with bill, 10/15/20 % buttons, people; shows tip and total per person.
note: Math correct (80, 15%, 4 -> 12 / 23). Custom % container is display:none and never revealed, so custom tip unreachable. Default 15% used but no button highlighted at start; negative bill silently gives 0.

what_it_is: Tip calculator with 10/15/20 % buttons, a Custom button plus input, people count.
note: Per-person amount ignores the number of people (80, 15%, 4 people shows 92.00 instead of 23.00), so the central output is wrong. Clearing the custom field gives $NaN. Custom button works (the only app with an explicit Custom toggle); preset buttons all look active-coloured.

what_it_is: Tip calculator with bill, 10/15/20 % buttons, people, Reset button; shows tip and amount per person.
note: Math correct (80, 15%, 4 -> 12 / 23). Custom % container is display:none and only revealed via focus/blur on the hidden input, so custom tip unreachable. Reset button is a small extra; tip is 0 until a button is picked.

what_it_is: Tip calculator with prefilled bill 100 / 2 people / 15%, always-visible custom % field; shows tip, total bill and per-person amount.
note: All brief items work and numbers correct (80, 15%, 4 -> 12 / 23; custom 18 -> 14.40 / 23.60); results live on load; extra Total Bill row; active-state moves to custom field. Negative bill gives negative results without validation; clearing custom field does not restore a preset.

what_it_is: Tip calculator with presets plus an input embedded in a fourth 'custom' button; shows per-person tip, per-person total and grand total.

Custom field is visible, but results do not update while typing; they only update after clicking the button wrapper again (stale numbers). Own idea: input inside the button, extra grand-total line.

what_it_is: Tip calculator (bill 50 prefilled, 15% default) showing tip, per person and grand total.
note: Math correct (80, 15%, 4 -> 12 / 23, grand total 92). Custom input container is display:none and never revealed, so custom tip unreachable. Grand total row is a small extra; no input validation message.

what_it_is: Tip calculator with bill, presets, people; shows tip and what each person pays.

what_it_is: Tip calculator with bill, 10/15/20 % buttons, people count; shows tip and total per person.

Only reachable programmatically, where numbers are right (80, 15%, 4 -> 12 / 23). Results stay $0.00 for a real user.
